### ① Derived judgments

Rendered in-seat by the skills seat 1 session at the served tier the maintainer named on the previous date (the fable tier word at `get_session` → `external_metadata.last_served_model`; ruling record 5771798588). The contract is the triage grading 5782685945 on #19706 (`domain:skills`, p2, Bug, `area:api` — in scope the lowercase `code` half only; the bracketed `[tag]` opener rides #19705): every `code` the two ADRs print in a refusal payload is a member of the published ledger `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` and the token the runtime emits for that refusal; the checklist item `api-backend.error-envelope-ledger` (P1) is the acceptance; ⛔ a code the runtime never emits is not invented.

- **(a) The diff — measured by this seat on a review worktree at the head.** One single-parent commit on `dc1b98680`; two files, +4 / −4, four token edits and nothing else: `docs/adr/0005` :349 `invalid_metadata` → `INVALID_METADATA`; `docs/adr/0010` :480 `not_overridable` → `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, :483 `package_locked` → `ITEM_LOCKED`, :486 `item_locked` → `ITEM_LOCKED`; :489 `frozen_path` unchanged. The `[tag]` openers, the `status` numbers and every other byte of both records untouched.
- **(b) Each token is the runtime's, read by this seat in the tree.** `INVALID_METADATA`: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` :16096–:16100 (`saveMetaItem`'s spec-validation refusal — the very sentence the ADR-0005 sample prints — `code = 'INVALID_METADATA'`, `status = 422`); `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`: `protocol.ts` :15758–:15759 and `sys-metadata-repository.ts` :1639 / :1652–:1653 (`status = 403`); `ITEM_LOCKED` for L3: `protocol.ts` :14144–:14145 (`lockWriteRefusal`) and :14212–:14213; `ITEM_LOCKED` for L2: `sys-metadata-repository.ts` :1766–:1768 (`readOnlyBaseOverrideError` — `code = 'ITEM_LOCKED'`, `status = 403`, `lockSource = 'package'`), pinned by `sys-metadata-repository.package-writability.test.ts` :767 — no `PACKAGE_LOCKED` exists anywhere in the tree, and ADR-0010's own §3.2 (:161) normalises a package-layer lock into the single `_lock` + `_lockSource: 'package'` shape the protocol code sees; so the L2 edit is a MAPPING to the member that exists, ⛔ not an uppercasing, and the PR body puts that one judgment to the maintainer. Ledger rows: :615 / :617 / :623.
- **(c) The fifth site is a measured negative, not an omission.** L4 (`frozen_path`, :489): no ledger member, and no producer — `_frozenPaths` / `defaultFrozenPaths` have zero readers under `packages/**` (the only hit is the header comment of `spec/src/kernel/metadata-protection.zod.ts`), the Phase 2 evaluator does not exist, and ADR-0010 carries no Implemented mark for it; the control leg finds the L1 / L3 emitters. Left unchanged under the dispatch's ⛔ no-invention clause; the answer is the spec lane's (register a code when L4 is implemented, or amend ADR-0010 to mark L4 unimplemented) — put to the maintainer as a note, ⛔ not this PR's.
- **(d) Acceptance — the ledger membership, re-read by this seat.** Every `"code":` value in the two ADRs against the ledger's quoted rows: before 0 / 5 members; after 4 / 5 — the residue is L4 by design. The dev's `tsx` probe over `ErrorCode.options` (338 members) reads the same rows.
- **(e) Gates — re-run by this seat on the review worktree at the head after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`.** `check-adr-links` 0 (690 destinations resolve); `check-adr-symbol-anchors` 0 (2121 anchors); `check:adr-anchors` 0; `check:doc-authoring` 0; `check:nul-bytes` 0; `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 19765` exit 3 — GOVERNED, Tier H (`docs/adr/** ×2`, 8 changed lines). The dev's derivation: 19 families by `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, `--ran` 19 / 19 / 0 NOT-MEASURED (one first-pass exit 3 prerequisite on `check:doc-formula-expressions`, cured by the declared build through the verify lock, re-run 0), plus `check:error-code-casing` run as a neighbour (it scans `packages/**` `.ts` only — it cannot read ADR prose, which is why nothing caught this). CI at this head at the seat's read: 30 latest-per-name check runs — 19 success, 9 skipped, 2 in progress; the 四件套 waits for green.

### ② Semver level

None — no release. `docs/adr/**` is in no package's `files[]` (the dev measured 70 manifests, 0 resolving to `docs/adr`); `skip-changeset` written through `label-write.mjs` with read-back.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Tier H** (`docs/adr/**` on the register): draft stays draft; the 四件套 by this seat on green — ACCEPT on the card, `needs-user-decision`, 席位意见, review requested from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`; the maintainer merges after confirming the L2 mapping.
- **The dev's two open questions, graded in-lane**: L2 → **A** (`ITEM_LOCKED` documents the contract that exists; a distinct `PACKAGE_LOCKED` would be a wire change for a condition the runtime already answers, against §3.2 — a spec-lane decision with no measured consumer); L4 → **A** (leave the line until L4 is implemented and its code is registered; B — amend ADR-0010 to mark L4 unimplemented — is cheap if the maintainer wants the record honest today; C is not viable, the ledger refuses a code no package stamps). Both stated in the 席位意见 for the maintainer's word.
- **Report** 5787309652 on the card parses (`os-dev-report` first line — the id is on the thread); `mcp_calls` 0; three REST writes plus two pushes; no body PATCH by the dev.
- **Out of scope, noted by the dev, ⛔ not touched**: `packages/cli/src/commands/meta/delete.ts` :115 (`--if-match` help text says `409 metadata_conflict`, the CLI surfaces `METADATA_CONFLICT`; `delete-reset-carriers.test.ts` :367 pins the help text) — non-governed, class a, a card the seat cannot file (the filing door) → the maintainer's items; ADR-0010 prose outside the payload lines still spells codes lowercase (:97, :103, :213, :501, :601–:602) — rides the prose round on #19705; the L2 payload's other fields describe the unimplemented Phase 3 surface — token-only scope, noted.
